observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon lens with visible text “AF-S NIKKOR” and “50mm 1/8G” (appears to read 50mm f/1.8G).
Photo 1 shows the front element and the side label area with “Nikon” and “AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G” style markings.
Photo 2 shows the front element and the lens name ring area; “Nikon” and “AF-S NIKKOR” are visible, and “50mm 1.8G” appears on the barrel.
No photo clearly shows the exact mount type (e.g., F-mount) or any serial number, box, or receipt.

claims.evidence: Photos show a Nikon 50mm f/1.8G lens but do not show origin (country of purchase/shipping).
Photos show the lens, but cleaning/condition “like new” and absence of internal haze/fungus cannot be confirmed from these angles.
Photos show “50mm” on the lens barrel (photo 0/1/2).

risks.risk: Lens may have internal haze/fungus or scratches not visible in these photos, affecting image quality.
risks.proof: Request a short video/clip through the front element at an angle with strong light (flashlight) showing the glass surface and any haze/fungus, plus a photo of the rear element.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed clean (worst case: treat as needing cleaning/possible minor defects).

risks.risk: Mount compatibility risk (F-mount vs other mount) and whether it fits the buyer’s camera.
risks.proof: Request a clear photo of the rear mount contacts and the mount label (showing it is Nikon F-mount), plus a photo of the lens attached to the seller’s camera (rear view).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incompatible until confirmed.

risks.risk: Aperture/AF performance not testable remotely (focus motor/AF-S behavior, aperture clicks).
risks.proof: Request a clip showing AF focusing on a subject and a still photo at wide open (f/1.8) and stopped down (e.g., f/2.8) to confirm aperture control.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst case: assume AF/aperture may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps, hood) or damaged lens hood/threads.
risks.proof: Request photos of included items laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood if any) and a close-up of filter/threads.

proof_requests: Clear rear-mount photo showing the exact mount type/contacts (and ideally lens attached to a Nikon/F-mount body).
Video/flashlight check of both front and rear glass for haze/fungus/scratches.
AF test clip (AF-S focusing) and aperture test (shoot at f/1.8 and f/2.8) to confirm functionality.
Photos of all accessories included (front cap, rear cap, hood) and close-up of filter/threads.
response.reason: The lens type (Nikon AF-S 50mm f/1.8G) is readable from the photos, but key factors that determine price in Oyo—glass condition, mount compatibility, and AF/aperture functionality—cannot be confirmed from these images alone.
